comparison.objective: Break and recover four insert tangs; record opens an obstructed locker and removes a leaning case upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs millimetre coaxial impact manipulation; record manages a coupled door/load interaction while stabilizing and extracting a bulky case.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fragments and undamaged retained inserts; record requires the locker opened and case removed upright without dropping or unsafe displacement. Candidate quantitative damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Obstruction management and bulky-object extraction test a different physical ability from impact fracture and small-fragment handling.
